# MP0025

Creates HttpClient inside a module; use context.Network.Http for pipeline resilience, logging, and HTTP interception.

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Category | Usage |
| Default severity | Warning |
| Availability | Public analyzer package |

## Configure severity

```ini title=".editorconfig"
dotnet_diagnostic.MP0025.severity = warning
```

Use `none` to disable the rule, or `silent`, `suggestion`, `warning`, or `error` to change its severity.

## Suppress a specific occurrence

```csharp
#pragma warning disable MP0025
// Code that intentionally violates MP0025.
#pragma warning restore MP0025
```
